items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: He got me a few record dates on his label, Roost label. And he was recording -- like we were the house musicians. Cozy Cole and Sanford Gold Goal, a piano player.

ctx.x: So you first got to know the Young family when you were --

Now, I met Lee as a dancer. And Lee got hooked on drums behind Cozy Cole[.]. See Stuff Smith came out here and played the Famous Door and Cozy was chewing gum, you know. And this hotel room, he didn't have a practice pad. He had one of these restaurant plates wrapped up in a bath towel and he'd use that for a practice pad. And Lee would just hang around him all the time. And by Lee being a dancer, he had the rhythm concept, you know. And he bought him a pair of drums, a drum set and within a month he was swinging…

And then he got in the book. And started learning his paradiddles and his ratamacues and everything flam you know, like Cozy was doing. And he got real agressive as a drummer. He took over the city as a drummer practically because when he joined King Cole. He was, his reading was such that he could conduct a band. And if anyone in the band made a mistake on reading their part, he'd jump up off the drums and go and correct them, you know. And they say "wow".
